b1-conosur-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Chile under Pinochet
b1-conosur-01.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg have watched a documentary about Chile, and she asks what happened after the coup.
b1-conosur-01.prompt: Tell Meg what was banned after the coup and what was approved in 1980.
cues: Say what was banned after the coup
b1-conosur-01.target: Después del golpe se prohibieron los partidos de izquierda, y en 1980 se aprobó una nueva constitución.
b1-conosur-01.english: After the coup the parties of the left were banned, and in 1980 a new constitution was approved.
b1-conosur-01.canDo: I can say what was done in Chile under Pinochet and how the dictatorship ended, using se.

b1-conosur-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Malvinas War
b1-conosur-02.scenario: You are Meg. You read about Argentina for a class, and Carlos asks what the government did in April 1982.
b1-conosur-02.prompt: Tell Carlos what the government ordered on 2 April 1982 and what the country was going through.
cues: Say what the country was going through
Say what the government ordered and when
b1-conosur-02.target: El 2 de abril de 1982, mientras el país vivía una crisis, el gobierno ordenó la invasión de las Malvinas.
b1-conosur-02.english: On 2 April 1982, while the country was going through a crisis, the government ordered the invasion of the Malvinas.
b1-conosur-02.canDo: I can tell what happened in Argentina in 1982 and 1983, contrasting the preterite and the imperfect.

b1-conosur-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Democracy in Uruguay
b1-conosur-03.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are reading about Uruguay for a class, and she asks what was special about its democracy.
b1-conosur-03.prompt: Tell Meg what many historians say about Uruguay's democracy before 1973.
cues: Name the source of the opinion
Say that its democracy was one of the most stable in the region
b1-conosur-03.target: Según muchos historiadores, Uruguay tenía una de las democracias más estables de la región.
b1-conosur-03.english: According to many historians, Uruguay had one of the most stable democracies in the region.
b1-conosur-03.canDo: I can say what made Uruguay's democracy stand out and how the dictatorship ended, using superlatives.

b1-conosur-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Operation Condor
b1-conosur-04.scenario: You are Meg. You saw an exhibition about the dictatorships, and Carlos asks what Operation Condor was.
b1-conosur-04.prompt: Tell Carlos what Operation Condor was and when it began.
cues: Say that it was a network and what its aim was
Say when and where it began
b1-conosur-04.target: En noviembre de 1975 nació en Santiago la Operación Cóndor, una red cuyo objetivo era perseguir a los opositores.
b1-conosur-04.english: In November 1975 Operation Condor began in Santiago, a network whose aim was to pursue opponents.
b1-conosur-04.canDo: I can say what Operation Condor was and when and where it began, using cuyo.

b1-conosur-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Justice in Spite of the Laws
b1-conosur-05.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are talking about Argentina after a class, and she asks what happened after the laws of 1986 and 1987.
b1-conosur-05.prompt: Tell Meg what the organisations did in spite of those laws.
cues: Say that there were laws that limited trials
Say what the organisations kept doing in spite of them
b1-conosur-05.target: A pesar de esas leyes, muchas organizaciones siguieron pidiendo justicia.
b1-conosur-05.english: In spite of those laws, many organisations kept asking for justice.
b1-conosur-05.canDo: I can say what stood in the way of justice in Argentina, Chile and Uruguay, using a pesar de.

b1-conosur-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Dictatorships in Review
b1-conosur-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are going over your notes on the Southern Cone for a class, and he asks what you remember about Chile.
b1-conosur-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos what was banned and closed in Chile after the coup.
b1-conosur-consolidation.target: Se prohibieron los partidos de izquierda y se cerró el Congreso.
b1-conosur-consolidation.english: The parties of the left were banned and Congress was closed.
b1-conosur-consolidation.canDo: I can use se with a verb to say what was done under a dictatorship.
